attributes.description: Map of user-defined string attributes associated with recipient.

contactId.description: An id of existing contact used as recipient.

dialplanXml.description: An IVR xml document describing dialplan.

liveMessage.description: Text to be turned into a sound, this will be played when the phone is answered.

liveMessageSoundId.description: An id of a sound file to play if phone is answered.

machineMessage.description: Text to be turned into a sound, this will be played when answering machine is detected.

machineMessageSoundId.description: An id of a sound file to play if answering machine is detected.

phoneNumber.description: Recipient's phone number in E.164 format.

transferDigit.description: A digit pressed to initiate the transfer.

transferMessage.description: Text to be turned into a sound, this will be played when the transfer digit is pressed.

transferMessageSoundId.description: An id of a sound file to play if call is transferred.

transferNumber.description: Phone number to transfer the call to.
